# Host platform catalogs

Published host catalogs for plugin authors (Wave F4.2). These pages are generated from the same data structures used by `apps/api/sdk/plugin` and `sforum extension test`.

Source of truth: Go catalogs under `apps/api` (`app/Support/Events`, `Capabilities`, `ExtensionManifest`, `Jobs`, and provider slot constants). Regenerate with:

```bash
cd apps/api && go run ./cmd/sforum extension docs generate
```

Or verify CI drift:

```bash
cd apps/api && go run ./cmd/sforum extension docs generate --check
```

## Pages

| Document | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| [events.md](./events.md) | Observe / filter / validate events plugins may declare |
| [capabilities.md](./capabilities.md) | Host capability grants (risk tiers) |
| [contribution-points.md](./contribution-points.md) | UI/admin contribution points |
| [provider-slots.md](./provider-slots.md) | Provider slots plugins may fill |
| [schedules.md](./schedules.md) | Core host schedules (plugins must not private-cron) |

## Authoring

- Hand-written guide: [../authoring-guide.md](../authoring-guide.md)
- Go SDK: `github.com/zhuchunshu/sforum/apps/api/sdk/plugin`

- Reference plugins: built-in `sforum.smtp`, fixtures under `extensions/fixtures/plugins/`
